description: The file defines a SwiftUI view named VoiceWakeWordsSettingsView, which provides a user interface for managing wake word trigger words used in voice recognition features. It includes functionality for adding, removing, resetting, and persisting trigger words, as well as updating global app state accordingly.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Appends a new empty string to the list of trigger words.

methods.name: removeWords
methods.description: Removes trigger words at specified offsets; resets to default if list becomes empty.

methods.name: binding
methods.description: Provides a binding to a specific trigger word at a given index for user editing.

methods.name: commitTriggerWords
methods.description: Saves the current trigger words persistently and updates the global app wake word state asynchronously.
